selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of disk-backed swap
selected_evidence.summary: The swapfile is 536,870,912 bytes with 1,048,576 allocated 512-byte blocks; it persisted across restart with secure ownership and SELinux labeling.
Both before and after restart, /swapfile is active with 536,866,816 usable bytes and priority 100. It is the only active swap entry.
The validated fstab entry uses defaults,pri=100. After restart, systemd reports swapfile.swap active, generated from /etc/fstab, and the current-boot journal records successful activation.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
selected_evidence.summary: AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 match before and after the change.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 9bdcc129-3d25-48ff-ad64-56be332fb91e; the native reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 7e7d3f68-355d-4eb0-9266-78891270078b; system state returned to running with no failed units and persistent swap active.

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
if [ -e /swapfile ]; then printf 'refusing: /swapfile already exists\n' >&2; exit 1; fi
dd if=/dev/zero of=/swapfile bs=1M count=512 conv=fsync status=none
chmod 600 /swapfile
mkswap -L antrieb-swap /swapfile
ls -lZ /swapfile
stat -c 'size_bytes=%s blocks_512=%b mode=%a owner=%U:%G' /swapfile
